findings.summary: The containment check uses abspath, which does not resolve symlinks, so a symlink below root serves files from anywhere on disk.
The response headers are written into the shared options dict, so the no-cache of an index page sticks to every later file response and changes the caller's headers dict.
The routes are registered before root is checked, so a failed call still leaves routes that shadow later ones.

static_file() now compares against root without a trailing separator, so for root /srv/pub a request for ../pub-private/key.txt passes the containment check and files from any sibling directory whose name starts with the root's name are served.
